description:
Cross-platform SSH, SFTP, and terminal client for developers, sysadmins, and homelabs.

ZestSSH is a cross-platform SSH, SFTP, and terminal client for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, with remote screens over VNC and Remote Desktop (RDP) in the same tabs. It brings a tabbed desktop shell with split panes, jump-host chaining, port forwarding, an SFTP file browser, snippets and workflows, live server monitoring, and optional end-to-end encrypted sync across every device, all backed by a single shared connection library.
ZestSSH 4.0.1, Room to Work: the file editor opens in the workspace with a tab of its own instead of covering the window; Edit for several hosts can move or copy them to another vault or team; the lock screen can show your open sessions; VNC servers get three minutes to connect; fixes for RDP to Windows Server 2022 with RDS licensing, the pointer over a remote screen's side bars, paste and SFTP long names.
